rules.name: cash-refresh-17-cache-parity-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT l.trade_id, l.active_lots FROM (SELECT a.trade_id, a.active_lots, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.trade_id ORDER BY a.value_date DESC) AS rn FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = a.business_unit WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.business_unit = :bu AND a.value_date <= v.value_date) l WHERE l.rn = 1
SELECT c.trade_id, c.active_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu

expect.reason: every trade with a lots row up to the valuation date is in the cache
the cache holds no trade that the history does not give
same latest active lots per trade
one row per trade on both sides
